events.name: San Diego Chargers at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: Emmanuel Sanders waited six long weeks to join the list of players who have caught a touchdown pass from Peyton Manning. Now, he has four in less than a week.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos top Chargers as Sanders grabs 3 TDs

headlines.description: Matt Prater kicked a 48-yard field goal on the last play of the game Sunday, lifting the Detroit Lions to a 22-21 comeback win over the Atlanta Falcons after trailing by 21 points.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions erase 21-point deficit to stun Falcons

headlines.description: Dalton's sneak rallies Bengals over Ravens 27-24
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton sneaks Bengals past Ravens on late TD

headlines.description: Foster scores 3 TDs as Texans beat Titans 30-16

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Chiefs score 34 unanswered in 34-7 rout of Rams
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs score 34 unanswered in 34-7 rout of Rams

events.name: Chicago Bears at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw five scoring passes and the streaking New England Patriots crammed three touchdowns into the last two minutes of the first half, cruising to a 51-23 win over the staggering Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws 5 TDs as Patriots throttle Bears

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Kyle Orton threw four touchdown passes and the Buffalo Bills forced the New York Jets into six turnovers -- three each by Geno Smith and Michael Vick -- in a 43-23 rout Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Orton throws 4 TD as Bills blast TO-prone Jets

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Barr's scores on fumble return, Vikings win in OT
headlines.shortLinkText: Barr's scores on fumble return, Vikings win in OT

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a 23-yard touchdown pass to Luke Willson with 47 seconds left, lifting the Seattle Seahawks to a 13-9 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Sunday to snap a two-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson's late TD pass helps Seattle snap skid

headlines.description: Bortles' mistakes help Dolphins beat Jaguars 27-13
headlines.shortLinkText: Bortles' mistakes help Dolphins beat Jaguars 27-13

headlines.description: Carson Palmer lofted a 75-yard touchdown pass to rookie John Brown with 1:21 to play to give the Arizona Cardinals a stunning 24-20 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles in a matchup of two of the NFL's four remaining one-loss teams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards edge Eagles on rookie's 75-yard TD

headlines.description: Roethlisberger throws 6 TDs as Steelers top Colts
headlines.shortLinkText: Roethlisberger throws 6 TDs as Steelers top Colts

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees completed 27 of 32 passes for 311 yards and three touchdowns, and the Saints ended the Packers' four-game winning streak, 44-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees-led Saints cruise, end Packers' streak

headlines.description: Colt McCoy directed Washington to Kai Forbath's 40-yard field goal in OT and Dallas was unable to answer after Tony Romo returned from an apparent injury, sending the Redskins to a 20-17 victory Monday that snapped the Cowboys' six-game winning streak.
